product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic provides multichannel business messaging across SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and LINE for sales, marketing, and service teams engaging leads, customers, and prospects.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reported 312 employees as of May 31, 2026; this falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn and the company contact page identify Henderson as its headquarters/Global-U.S. headquarters; the careers page also contains older copy describing Pune as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product, marketing, and messaging-advice posts rather than an engineering blog with multiple product-build posts.

public_docs.notes: The public Technical Resource Center includes multiple documentation categories, release notes, and a developer guide.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-role inventory as of November 6, 2026 lists 20 jobs, and none of the job titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The documentation describes an optional OpenAI integration for customers’ existing models, not a claim that OpenAI is the product’s default model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page identifies ISO 27001 as a security standard; HIPAA and GDPR are listed separately as industry-based compliance, not as certifications.

last_funding.notes: A 2025 profile reports US$5,000 in friends-and-family support for the first prototype but gives no transaction date; Tracxn reports no formal funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported friends-and-family support funded the original prototype in the company’s early days, and Tracxn reports no funding rounds; no funding in the May 9, 2025-November 9, 2026 window was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The November 6, 2026 open-role list includes an Account Executive and SDR positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 26, 2026 release highlights introduce an enhanced consent-management experience within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The located COO appointment announcement was dated October 1, 2025, before the 12-month window beginning November 9, 2025; the available leadership information was not sufficient to establish that no other C-level or VP change occurred.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce and Zoho are named CRM platforms; the trust subprocessor list names Pardot, MailChimp, and Zapier for marketing-related uses.
